subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and if so what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The request is useful and source-reproducible, but it adds a new authenticated upload and workspace-write capability, so automation should not choose the product or security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Upload Design
options.body: Add a narrow admin-scoped upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing read-only avatar serving protections.

options.title: Keep Existing Manual Paths
options.body: Continue supporting manual `identity.avatar`/`IDENTITY.md` configuration plus browser-local Quick Settings overrides, avoiding new server-side upload risk.

options.title: Defer Core Upload
options.body: Leave this open or close by maintainer decision until a broader Control UI identity-management design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Upload Design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow admin-scoped upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing read-only avatar serving protections.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current-main and merged-history signal across the avatar route, agent RPC registry, and Control UI avatar behavior.
